description: This file implements the client-side proxy and server-side binder transaction handling for the IOMX interface in Android's media framework, including method definitions for node management, parameter configuration, buffer handling, and message passing.

classes.name: BpOMX
classes.description: Client-side proxy class for the IOMX interface, forwarding calls over binder IPC.

classes.name: BnOMX
classes.description: Server-side binder class handling incoming transactions for the IOMX interface.

classes.name: BpOMXObserver
classes.description: Client-side proxy for the IOMXObserver interface, sending messages.

classes.name: BnOMXObserver
classes.description: Server-side binder class handling incoming messages for IOMXObserver.

methods.name: listNodes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available OMX component nodes.

methods.name: allocateNode
methods.description: Allocates a new OMX node with specified name and observer.

methods.name: freeNode
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated OMX node.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to an OMX node.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves parameters from an OMX node.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets parameters on an OMX node.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data from an OMX node.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration data on an OMX node.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Gets the current state of an OMX node.

methods.name: useBuffer
methods.description: Provides a buffer to an OMX node.

methods.name: useGraphicBuffer
methods.description: Provides a graphic buffer to an OMX node.

methods.name: allocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a buffer for an OMX node.

methods.name: freeBuffer
methods.description: Frees a buffer from an OMX node.

methods.name: emptyBuffer
methods.description: Empties a buffer, indicating data consumption.

methods.name: getExtensionIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the index of an extension parameter.
